body:
Server admin, registered users (both clients): when a long e-mail pushes the buttons onto their own
line, they sit at the start; they belong at the end, as beside the e-mail. The "Reset password"
button is shorter ("Reset pwd" in English, shorter forms where a locale has a common one) so fewer
rows wrap. The confirm dialog keeps its title, body and "Reset" button.
title: Admin user rows: buttons end-aligned when they wrap, shorter reset label
